review.notes: Independent fixing review of the ComplexComparisonPartII package (README, Suggested.lean, metadata) against its accepted plan, by Claude (session claude-PKnYVi), who did not write the package. Upstream form, fidelity (all 97 plan nodes traced; all 71 README targets present in the Lean or its closing list), own words (shingle comparison with every source text), tiers (cites only AlgebraicModuli t4, SchemeAndStackFoundations t2, DiamondsAndVStacks t3, Tau Ceti and TauCetiRoadmap main) and duplication against TauCetiRoadmap main and Tau Ceti a91d3aaf were checked. Fixed: CohomologicalPointCounting/ComplexComparison (open TauCetiRoadmap PR #196) removed as a supplier; D0/cech-to-derived-comparison renamed DiamondsAndVStacks D0.19; unsupported SF.2 hypercohomology citations replaced by Mathlib DerivedCategory with a truncation-triangle proof; Ext comparison attributed to properSchemeGagaPushforward; TauCeti.montel, current-library singular cohomology, small-chain subdivision and Fredholm compact perturbation cited with one-clause differences; worked example 4 no longer leans on tier-11 ModularCurvesPartII. About 110 locators across all 20 sources were checked against public copies; some 30 wrong items or claims were corrected (e.g. Demailly II.9.12, VI.1.1-1.2, VI.1.6, I.3.29 proof; SGA 1 XII 1.3 and 4.2; Serre's Theorem A sketch and expose 19 numbering; Hall Thm 9.1 for etale descent; Sella's smallness and quasi-isomorphism; DGH and Grothendieck for the 2pi i period; Deligne II.6.2, II.4.1 pages, residue sequence II.3.5-3.7; Kato on saturation) and page ranges tightened. Unit tests: AnalyticTwist.dual (not direction-detecting) replaced by h0(P1,O(1))=2; AnalyticCycleIntegration.line test form made compactly supported. Lean: IsSaturatedSubmonoid made intrinsic (Q^gp, not the ambient group) with a new 2N-is-saturated example; montelTheorem now concludes holomorphy of the limit, with #check @TauCeti.montel; a docstring corrected. Adversarial pass of every sign, normalisation and degenerate case recorded in the report; no statement needed a new hypothesis. lean-check before: exit 0, 33 sorry warnings only; after: exit 0, 34 sorry warnings only (496 lines). intake check-files: 0 problems. Remaining for the maintainer: AlgebraicModuli's proper GAGA proof uses C1 analytic inputs planned here (bundle or move C0.1/C0.5/C1 down); fibreDimensionLoci analyticity rests on Whitney 9F (not freely available), used only for the B_k corollary.
